newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia industry output up 0.9 pct in Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia industry output up 0.9 pct in Jan-Sept.

text.p: Mongolia's industrial production rose 0.9 percent or 1.5 billion tugriks to 165.7 billion tugriks in January-September 1996 from the year-earlier period, official statistics received on Thursday showed.
Production of 38.9 percent or 42 items of the total 108 items of state owned entities was increasing in the period, including copper concentrate and gold production.
Copper concentrate in the first three quarters increased 1.1 percent to 262,500 tonnes, up from 259,700 tonnes in the same period of 1995.
Gold production jumped 32.6 percent to 3,585 kg from 2,704.8 kg, the statistics said.
